sections.title: Introduction

sections.text: November 16, 1938: LSD is first synthesized by Swiss chemist Dr. Albert Hofmann at the Sandoz Laboratories in Basel, Switzerland.
sections.title: This Day in Skepticism

sections.text:
Item #1: New World porcupines, like New World monkeys, have prehensile tails they use to climb trees.
Item #2: While porcupines cannot shoot their quills, some species can throw them a short distance by whipping their tails.
Item #3: A recent study documented porcupines killings dogs, foxes, and even badgers with their quills.
Item #4: Porcupine quills are coated in a natural antibiotic.
sections.title: Science or Fiction

sections.text: 'For every complex problem there is an answer that is clear, simple, and wrong.' H. L Mencken
